info.title: Agilpay WebApi
info.description: Agilpay Payment Gateway REST API v6. All endpoints (except /oauth/token) require a Bearer JWT token obtained from the OAuth2 token endpoint using Client Credentials grant.

servers.description: Sandbox — use for testing and integration development. No real charges are made.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Obtain OAuth2 Bearer tokens using Client Credentials grant. **Call this first** — every other endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

tags.name: Transactions
tags.description: Payment processing: authorize, refund, void, capture, and ACH credit disbursements.

tags.name: Tokenization
tags.description: Securely store and manage payment methods as reusable tokens, reducing PCI scope.

tags.name: Information
tags.description: Query transactions, validate payment data, retrieve balances and available services.

post.description: Generates a JWT Bearer token using the OAuth2 Client Credentials grant. **This token must be sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other API call.** Tokens expire after 3600 seconds (1 hour); request a new one before expiry.

Performs a card-not-present or ACH payment authorization. Set `HoldFunds: true` for a pre-authorization (capture later via CaptureByID). Set `SaveWallet: true` to automatically tokenize the account for future use.

400.description: Bad request — validation error or missing required fields

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

403.description: Forbidden — token valid but insufficient permissions

post.summary: Authorize a payment using a stored token
post.description: Performs a payment authorization using a previously registered account token (card or ACH). The token is retrieved via RegisterToken or returned in a prior transaction response.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

post.summary: Register a card or ACH account token
post.description: Tokenizes a card or ACH account and associates it with a CustomerID. The returned AccountToken can be used in future AuthorizeToken, RefundToken, and Recurring calls. No charge is made.

requestBody.description: Card or ACH account details to tokenize

get.description: Returns all active payment tokens (cards and ACH accounts) registered under a CustomerID.

parameters.name: CustomerID
parameters.description: The customer identifier used when registering tokens

post.description: Permanently deletes a tokenized card or ACH account for a customer. This action cannot be undone.
Processes a refund by supplying the original card or ACH details. Use RefundByID when you have the original IDTransaction, or RefundToken when using a stored token.

post.summary: Process a refund using a stored token
post.description: Refunds a transaction using a stored account token.
Processes a refund referencing the original IDTransaction. Supports full and partial refunds. For partial refunds, include the Amount field.
Voids (cancels) an authorized or pre-authorized transaction before settlement, using its IDTransaction. Void is only possible before the batch is closed.

post.summary: Void a sale by auth/audit number
post.description: Voids a sale using its AuthNumber, ReferenceCode, and AuditNumber instead of IDTransaction. Use when you don't have the internal transaction ID.
Captures (settles) a pre-authorization created with `HoldFunds: true`. The amount captured will equal the original authorized amount.

post.summary: Capture a pre-authorized transaction with amount adjustment
post.description: Captures a pre-authorization and adjusts the final amount (e.g., to add tip). The new Amount must not exceed the original authorized amount unless allowed by your acquirer configuration.

get.description: Retrieves full transaction details using the internal IDTransaction returned in the authorization response.

parameters.name: IDTransaction
parameters.description: Internal transaction ID returned in the authorization response

get.description: Returns a list of transactions matching the given invoice/reference number. Date range and other filters are optional.

parameters.name: invoice
parameters.description: Invoice or reference number to search for

parameters.name: response_code
parameters.description: Filter by processor response code (e.g. '00' for approved). Optional.

parameters.name: transaction_type
parameters.description: Filter by type: SALE, REFUND, VOID, CAPTURE. Optional.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: APPROVED, DECLINED, PENDING. Optional.

post.description: Retrieves outstanding balance and invoice information for a customer. Typically used in bill payment flows.

Closes the current open batch and initiates settlement with the acquirer. `Client_Id` identifies the affiliate/site; `MerchantKey` identifies the terminal. Set `ForzarBatch: true` to force close even if the batch is empty.

get.description: Performs a Luhn algorithm check on the provided card number. Returns true if the number is structurally valid. Does not validate against the card network or check if the card is active.

parameters.name: CardNumber
parameters.description: Card number (digits only, no spaces or dashes)

200.description: true if the card number passes the Luhn check; otherwise false

get.description: Validates a US bank routing number (ABA) using the standard checksum algorithm.

get.summary: Get bill payment services for a client
get.description: Returns the list of bill payment services (billers/utilities) available for a given client_id. Used in bill payment and top-up flows before calling the Bill Payments Authorize endpoint.

post.description: Sets up a new pre-authorized recurring payment schedule for a customer. The AccountToken must be previously registered via RegisterToken.
Updates an existing recurring payment schedule. Fields not provided will retain their current values.

get.description: Retrieves the full details and transaction history of a recurring payment agreement.

parameters.name: Service
parameters.description: Service identifier for the recurring plan

post.description: Changes the status of a recurring payment. Use the `Status` field in the request body with values: ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED.

Credits (pushes) funds to an ACH checking or savings account. This is the reverse of a debit authorization — money moves from the merchant to the customer's bank account. Use for refunds, disbursements, or payouts to ACH accounts.

Supports ACH-Checking (`AccountType: 2`) and ACH-Savings (`AccountType: 3`) only. Set `SaveWallet: true` to tokenize the account for future use.

requestBody.description: ACH account details and credit amount

post.summary: Apply ACH credit using a stored token (push payment)
post.description: Credits funds to an ACH account using a previously stored token. Functionally equivalent to ApplyCredit but uses a stored `AccountToken` instead of raw account data.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token obtained from POST /oauth/token using Client Credentials grant.

OAuthTokenRequest.description: Client credentials for OAuth2 token request.

access_token.description: JWT Bearer token. Send this as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on all subsequent requests.

AuthorizeModel.description: Payment authorization request. Supports credit/debit cards and ACH. For card payments, provide AccountNumber + ExpirationMonth + ExpirationYear + CVV. For ACH, provide AccountNumber + RoutingNumber + AccountType.

MerchantKey.description: Merchant terminal key assigned by Agilpay

AccountType.description: Payment method type. Values: VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX, DISCOVER, CHECKING, SAVINGS

AccountNumber.description: Card number or ACH account number (plain text — transmitted over TLS)

RoutingNumber.description: ACH routing number (9 digits). Required for ACH transactions.

ExpirationMonth.description: Card expiration month (MM format, e.g. '07'). Required for card transactions.

ExpirationYear.description: Card expiration year (YY or YYYY format). Required for card transactions.

CustomerID.description: Your system's customer identifier. Used to associate tokens and transactions with a customer.

CustomerName.description: Cardholder or account holder full name

CustomerAddress.description: Customer street address (used for AVS verification)

CustomerState.description: Customer state (2-letter US state code, e.g. 'FL')

ZipCode.description: Billing ZIP code (used for AVS verification)

Amount.description: Transaction amount as a decimal string (e.g. '10.00'). Do not include currency symbols.

Tax.description: Tax amount as a decimal string (e.g. '1.50'). Optional.

CVV.description: Card CVV/CVC security code. Recommended for card-not-present transactions.

Invoice.description: Your reference/invoice number. Used to retrieve the transaction later via GetTransactionByReference.

Transaction_Detail.description: Free-text description of the transaction (appears on statements)

HoldFunds.description: Set to true for pre-authorization (no settlement). Funds are reserved but not captured. Capture later using CaptureByID or CaptureAdjustmendByID.

SaveWallet.description: Set to true to automatically tokenize the account and store it in the customer's wallet. The token is returned in AccountToken of the response.

ForceDuplicate.description: Set to true to bypass duplicate transaction detection and force processing. Use with caution.

ExtData.description: Extended data field for custom metadata. Format is implementation-specific — contact Agilpay for your configuration. Returned as-is in the response and webhooks.

IsInstallments.description: Set to true to process as an installment payment. Requires InstallmentsCount and acquirer support for installments.

InstallmentsCount.description: Number of installments (e.g. 3, 6, 12). Required when IsInstallments is true. Supported values depend on acquirer.

EffectiveDate.description: Effective date for ACH transactions. Optional.

IsDefault.description: When SaveWallet is true, marks this token as the customer's default payment method.

NameOnAccount.description: Name printed on the card or ACH account holder name

AuthorizeTokenModel.description: Token-based payment request. The AccountToken must be a token previously registered via RegisterToken or returned by a prior transaction.

AccountToken.description: Stored payment token obtained from RegisterToken or a prior transaction response

Tax.description: Tax amount as decimal string. Optional.

CVV.description: CVV for additional verification. Optional depending on acquirer configuration.

TransactionResponse.description: Standard transaction response returned by authorization, refund, void, and capture operations.

AccountToken.description: Token for the account used. Present when SaveWallet was true or when using RegisterToken.

IDTransaction.description: Agilpay internal transaction ID. Use this for VoidByID, CaptureByID, RefundByID, and GetTransactionByID.

AcquirerName.description: Name of the acquiring bank that processed the transaction

Status.description: Transaction status: APPROVED, DECLINED, PENDING, VOIDED, REFUNDED

ResponseCode.description: Agilpay response code. '00' = approved. See Response Code Table in documentation.

AuthNumber.description: Authorization number from the card network

HostDate.description: Date of processing at the host (YYYYMMDD)

HostTime.description: Time of processing at the host (HHmmss)

CardModelExtended.description: Card or ACH account details for tokenization. No payment is charged — this only registers the token.

AccountNumber.description: Card number or ACH account number

ExpirationMonth.description: Expiration month (MM). Required for card accounts.

ExpirationYear.description: Expiration year (YY or YYYY). Required for card accounts.

IsDefault.description: Mark as the customer's default payment method

AccountType.description: Account type: VISA, MASTERCARD, AMEX, DISCOVER, CHECKING, SAVINGS

RoutingNumber.description: ACH routing number. Required for CHECKING/SAVINGS accounts.

CVVNumber.description: Card CVV. Stored temporarily for initial validation only — not persisted.

AccountToken.description: Token to use in AuthorizeToken, RefundToken, and Recurring calls

IDTransaction.description: Internal transaction ID from the original authorization response

Amount.description: Amount for partial refund (RefundByID only). Omit for full void/refund.

AuthNumber.description: Authorization number from the original transaction response

ReferenceCode.description: Reference code from the original transaction

AuditNumber.description: Audit number from the original transaction

IDTransaction.description: Transaction ID of the pre-authorization to capture

Amount.description: Adjusted capture amount. Must not exceed the original authorized amount unless configured otherwise.

CloseBatchResumenRequest.description: Client_Id identifies the affiliate/site. MerchantKey identifies the terminal within that site.

Client_Id.description: Affiliate/site client ID assigned by Agilpay

Currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Required when the terminal operates multi-currency.

ForzarBatch.description: Set to true to force batch close even if the batch is empty or already closed

RecurringHeader.description: Recurring payment configuration. For status changes, only MerchantKey, CustomerId, Service, and Status are required.

Service.description: Service identifier for the recurring plan

AccountToken.description: Stored payment token to charge on each recurrence

Amount.description: Amount to charge on each recurrence

Frequency.description: Frequency value (e.g. 1 = every Period, 2 = every 2 Periods)

Period.description: Period unit: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY

Day.description: Day of the period to charge (e.g. 15 for the 15th of each month when Period=MONTHLY)

ToDate.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional when Quantity is set.

Status.description: Status for change operation: ACTIVE, PAUSED, CANCELLED

Retries.description: Number of retry attempts on failed charges

RecurringResponse.description: Recurring payment agreement details and history

LastProcessDate.description: Date of the last successful charge

Transactions.description: List of IDTransaction values for all charges made under this agreement

ThreeDS.description: 3D Secure authentication data. Include when the card has been authenticated through a 3DS flow before calling Authorize.

authenticationValue.description: CAVV / Authentication Value from the 3DS response

ApplyCreditRequest.description: ACH credit (push payment) request. Supports AccountType 2 (Checking) and 3 (Savings) only.

EffectiveDate.description: Effective date for ACH processing. Default: same business day

ApplyCreditTokenRequest.description: ACH credit using a stored token.
